tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam bcas bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ spangs rtogs yon tan mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sdug kun nye bar zhi ba dam pa'i chos/ /thar lam tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun btsong kha pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang pad dkar 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen/ /zla med bla ma gsum la gsol ba= /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i mdo sngags bstan/ /ji bzhin 'dzin pa'i grags pa rab 'bar zhing*/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blo gros gsal ldan pa/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi mar= /nges 'byung tshul khrims snying rje'i zhing sa las/ /legs 'khrungs lhag bsam dag pa'i ljon shing rdzogs/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las 'bras bu dri bsrung can/ /bshes gnyen dpag bsam ljon par= /mdo sngags gzhung dang tha snyad rig tshul kun/ /ji bzhin 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod rtsa ldan cing*/ /zab don gzigs la snyigs dus 'gran bral ba/ /yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes la= /brtan pa'i 'khor lo nyid kyis byin brlab pas/ /phyogs 'dir mdo sngags gzhung lugs spel ba la/ / shing rta chen po gnyis pa ltar gyur pa/ /zla med yongs 'dzin mchog la= /rgyal dang de sras gzhan gyi ring spangs shing*/ /'dul ba ma nus phyogs 'di'i gdul bya rnams/ /chos tshul sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs la= /thub pa'i nyi ma zhing gzhan gshegs pa'i shul/ /blo bzang smra ba'i zla ba ji bzhin du/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob dge ba'i bshes gnyen du/ /rnam rol rje btsun bla mar= /gzhung lugs mang du thos pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa spel snyam tshe/ /mgon de dgyes pa'i mtshan ma mngon gzigs pa/ /blo bzang bstan pa'i gnyen la= /thub bstan spyi dang blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /'dzin mdzad sngon byon da lta'i dus bzhugs dang*/ /ma 'ongs 'byon 'gyur ji snyed mchis rnams la/

/gsol ba 'debs so rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma mchog gsum rten 'brel bden stobs kyis/ /thub bstan bshad grub gnyis kyis 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /bshes gnyen tshogs rnams bstan pa'i dpal nyid du/ /bskal pa'i bar du rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam mchog gsum gyi/ /thugs rje byin rlabs bdag cag dad mos mthus/ /ma 'ongs skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /ngan song ngan 'gro'i gnas las thar gyur cig /rtag tu dal 'byor rten bzang rim brgyud de/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i skal pa che ldan zhing*/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ /mdo sngags chos tshul thos bsam mthar phyin shog /'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal rang bzhin las/ /ma 'das mthong nas thar pa don gnyer blo/ /tshul bzhin bskyed de snying rje'i rtsa ba can/ /byang chub sems mchog mngon du 'gyur bar shog /de nas phyin drug bslab gsum rim gnyis sogs/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i gnas rnams thams cad la/ /zhum pa med pa'i tshul gyis legs bslab nas/ /myur du rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /de nyid ma thob tshe rabs kun tu yang*/ /mi khom gnas las thar te dag pa'i zhing*/ /bde ba can du nges par skye ba dang*/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas mchod cing mnyes byed shog /zhing de'i gtso bo mgon po 'od dpag med/ /spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob la sogs/ /rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pas dgyes bzhin du/ /rjes su bzung nas 'gro ba'i don byed shog /rmad byung sras bcas zhes sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ /ces pa 'di ni/ sna lam pa rnams kyis shing glang lor ma ṇi bum sgrub byed pa'i thog tu kho bo cag bos pa'i tshe/ la mar nang gi bka' ram rnams bsnyen rdzogs pa rnams dang sna lam 'go ba dzud kan rgan po sogs skya ser thams cad kyis thun mong du rang la chos 'brel yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas gsol 'debs brtan zhugs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig gyis dang*/

ma ṇi'i bskul ma'i nang du 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes bskul ba la brten nas/ g.yo sa'i khri zur grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas rang nyid kyis rang la bstod pa mi 'os bzhin du bskul ba po rnams kyi ngo bzlog ma nus par g.yar khral tsam du myur bar sbyar ba ste/ dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i sna lam rab 'byams pa ngag dbang rab brtan gyis dad pas par du sgrub pa'i tshe/ par gyi yi ge pa ni tho lo'i tshe dbang mgon po'o/ /maṅgalaṃ// // ༄༅/ /gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs/ na mo shākya mu na ye/ dpal ldan rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang*/ / bde ldan zhing gi gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /de sras thu bo 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rab rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gsang sngags rig sngags bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /mgon de'i rnam 'phrul ind+ra bo dhi che/ /grub dbang padma kā rar gsol ba 'debs/ /de sras thu bo chos rgyal khri srong rje/ /dri med bshes gnyen bai ro tsa na dang*/ /nam mkha'i snying po rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs/ /sngon byon rig 'dzin rnams la= /bstan pa'i dpal gyur kun dga' rgyal mtshan rje/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston zhabs/ /thams cad mkhyen dngos blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /rje btsun blo bzang sbyin par= /rgyal ba gnyis par grags pa'i mdo sngags bstan/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas legs bzung nas/ /mchog dman 'gro la phan bde'i lam ston pa/ /yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes la= /gang gi bdag la mchod sbyin stsal rnams dang*/ khyad par gsang sngags chos tshul tshig bcad gcig /yan chad bka' drin mdzad pa'i drin can rje/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la= /mdor na mchog gsum yi dam lha tshogs dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan bsrung bcas rnams la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod cing skyabs su mchi/

/sgo gsum nyes pa'i tshogs rnams so sor bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /ji snyed bsags pa'i dge ba ma lus pa/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang myur du thob phyir bsngo/ /bdag cag gsang sngags theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /rtsa ba yan lag phyogs gtogs dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa nyams pa'i nyes kun mthol bshags kyis/ /slan chad mi bgyi byang zhing dag par mdzod/ /dam tshig sdom pa sna gcig yan srung dang*/ /yi dam lha la blo gtad gsol btab cing*/ /bsgom bzlas phyogs tsam bgyis pa'i rnam dkar dges/ /skye kun lhag pa'i lha yis rjes 'dzin shog /de yi mthu las rang gzhan don grub phyir/ /'bad tshe gzhan gyi nad gdon zhi ba sogs/ /zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe dpal bsod nams longs spyod rgyas pa sogs/ /rgyas pa'i las kun 'grub par= /'khor dang longs spyod gdul bya dbang sdud sogs/ /dbang gi las kun 'grub par= /gdug pa tshar gcod bsad rengs bskrad rmongs sogs/ /drag po'i las kun 'grub bar= /mdor na las bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan gyi don/ /ji bzhin byed pa'i mthu nus dpal ldan cing*/ /gang la gang 'tshams thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don/ /sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin go 'phang thob par shog /ji srid rgyal ba'i go 'phang ma thob par/ /de srid mi khom gnas las thar gyur te/ /lha mi'i rten bzang rim par thob pa dang*/ /gsang sngags sgrub pa'i skal ba ldan par shog /tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor rten rnyed tshe/ /dkar nag las 'bras phra la'ang nges rnyed de/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro mi 'dor zhing*/ /sdig spong dge ba mtha' dag sgrub par shog /rtag tu bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ /'phrad nas mdo sngags dam chos nyams blangs te/ /mar gyur 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang dam pa myur du thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang dad stobs ldan pa'i sna lam sngags 'chang rdo rje dbang phyug gis bskul ba'i ngo bor shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis thogs med du bris so/
/maṅgalaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ yongs 'dzin bla ma'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 184-- PAGE 183- -PAGE 180-
